purpose: Measure cross-CEM-iteration reuse of the fixed initial-observation and goal embeddings on the official LeWorldModel PushT CEM path.

assets.source: official LeWM PushT checkpoint and official PushT HDF5 dataset, pre-staged by the user or a CPU PBS preparation job

cache_contract.scope: one CEMSolver.solve call and one internal batch
cache_contract.cache_build: encode fixed initial observation and fixed goal once before the first CEM iteration
preserved: candidate RNG and first candidate replacement

timing.full_unit: one complete official CEMSolver.solve call for one fixed PushT info/goal batch and one paired solver RNG seed
timing.full_boundary: before solve entry through returned output, including info expansion, cache build or baseline repeated encodes, all CEM iterations, topk/update, and solver overhead
timing.inner_unit: sum of synchronized model.get_cost intervals over the same solve call; includes the first-call cache build and all candidate rollout/criterion work, excludes CEM sampling/topk/update and solve setup
timing.device_synchronization: torch.cuda.synchronize immediately before and after each full solve; CUDA events around each get_cost section

decision_gate.fallback: If not bitwise exact, every final action, first action, per-iteration topk indices, topk values, mean, variance, and cost trace must have max-abs difference <= 1e-5.
decision_gate.trace: final actions plus callback traces from all 30 CEM iterations

system_gate.statistic: median technical-repeat reduction across paired rows and then median over the two observations
